activity.role: Consul, statesman and First Triumvirate member
activity.notes: ATLAS uses 70–53 BCE as a representative public-leadership interval for Crassus, beginning with his first consulship and ending with his death at Carrhae. The interval includes his informal political alliance with Caesar and Pompey from 60 BCE and his second consulship in 55 BCE, but it does not assert one continuous constitutional office. The First Triumvirate was an informal alliance, so ATLAS does not create it as a sovereign polity or encode 'triumvir' as a formal magistracy for Crassus.
